bhajan.title: Bhajorey Sada Bhajo Rama Krishna Govinda

discourse.excerpt: Only when we are aware of the value of chanting the Lord's name will we make the effort to practise it and benefit from it. Devotees recite or sing the names of the Lord in two ways.
discourse.theme: The Lord's name is a priceless diamond — singing it alone purifies the singer, singing it together blesses the world.
discourse.title: Glorify the Lord's Name

reflection: Swami calls the Lord's name a diamond — only those who know its value treasure it and chant it. Keerthanam sung alone purifies the devotee; sankeerthanam sung together blesses the whole world. Today, set aside a few minutes and chant or sing one Name with love — Rama, Krishna, Sai — and notice the quiet that settles in. That peace is the name doing its work. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 19, 8 Nov 1986)
seva_nudge: Join or organise one group bhajan or singing session this week — at home, the Sai centre, or with friends — even for half an hour.
